name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Settings page pass: stripped the leftover decoration from the 0.0.82 layout (coloured pill badges, status dots, tinted card backgrounds on every friend/pool/subcard row) so it reads like a native Jellyfin plugin page — checked this against Trakt's and Webhook's own configPage.html conventions. Rows are now plain, separated by a hairline instead of a boxed card; nested panels (sharing, per-user rules, pools, connection details) are shown with a simple left-rule indent instead of a filled sub-card; status/error/warning text is plain coloured text instead of a background callout. No layout, tabs, or functionality changed — same Friends/Pools/Libraries/Advanced structure, same fields, same JS behaviour, only how it's painted. Goal: someone who never opens the README should still be able to tell what's going on at a glance.
